fix: The host and child controls detach their installed system IME association using ImmAssociateContext(hwnd, nullptr), limited to this process, so physical alphabet keys reach the isolated Rime session.
observation_note: Accessibility text can lag the captured image by one snapshot; output assertions used a refreshed stable tree.
limitations: These checks exercise only the isolated native host and its popup; TSF, IPC, Notepad, browser and VS Code are not tested.
No system input method installed, registered or made default.
No OS display scaling switch or multi-monitor test.
Final toolbar, context menu, settings and native animations remain outside this phase-3 desktop run.
